data.narrative:
Fossa Systems is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised €6.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, Impulse Space, and Apex Space.

Two standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable here. Peer-Median comparison fails due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Space & Aerospace segment—while 11 same-sector peers exist broadly, none of the filtered subsets yield the minimum 3 datapoints needed for statistical validity. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied because Fossa Systems' revenue is not disclosed; the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 23.9x P/S across the 6-ticker universe, but this multiple cannot be meaningfully applied without target revenue data.

This analysis is constrained by data limitations. A credible valuation range cannot be supported through quantitative triangulation given the absence of comparable transaction multiples, revenue figures for the target, or sufficient Stage A peers with disclosed valuations. Further diligence would require either Fossa Systems' revenue disclosure or identification of additional early-stage space company transactions with known entry multiples relative to capital raised. The €6.3M raised to date provides only a floor reference point, not a valuation anchor.
